sn56.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane Migadāye || || 2.
sn56.11:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn56.11:2.1: Dve me bhikkhave antā pabbajitena na sevittabbā ||
sn56.11:2.3: Yo cāyaṃ kāmesu kāmesu khallikānuyogo hīno gammo puthujjanīko anariyo anatthasaṃhito || yo cāyam attakilamathānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasaṃhito || ||
sn56.11:2.4: Ete te bhikkhave ubho ante anupakamma majjhimā paṭipadā Tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati || || 4.
sn56.11:3.1: Katamā ca sā bhikkhave majjhimā paṭipadā Tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati || ||
sn56.11:3.2: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn56.11:3.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi || ||
sn56.11:3.4: Ayam kho sā bhikkhave majjhimā paṭipadā Tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhu- ñaṇa- karaṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati || || 5.
sn56.11:4.1: Idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkham ariyasaccaṃ || ||
sn56.11:4.2: Jāti pi dukkhā jarā pi dukkhā vyādhi pi dukkhā maraṇam pi dukkhaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā pi dukkhā || appiyehi sampayogo dukkho piyehi vippayogo dukkho || yam picchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ || saṃkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā pi dukkhā || || 6.
sn56.11:4.3: Idam kho pana bhikkhave dukkhasamudayam ariyasaccaṃ || ||
sn56.11:4.4: Yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandī rāgasahagatā tatra tatrābhinandinī || seyyathīdaṃ || ||
sn56.11:4.6: Idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhanirodham ariyasaccaṃ || ||
sn56.11:4.7: Yo tassā yeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo || || 8.
sn56.11:4.8: Idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccam || ||
sn56.11:4.9: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn56.11:5.1: Idaṃ dukkham ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || ||
sn56.11:5.2: Taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkham ariyasaccam pariññeyyan ti me bhikkhave pubbe || la || pariññātan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || pe ||
sn56.11:6.1: Idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || ||
sn56.11:6.2: Taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhasamudayam ariyasaccam pahātabban ti me bhikkhave pubbe || la-pe ||
sn56.11:6.3: pahīnan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || pe || āloko udapādi || || 11.
sn56.11:7.1: Idaṃ dukkhanirodham ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || ||
sn56.11:7.2: Taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodham ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabban ti me bhikkhave pubbe || la-pe ||
sn56.11:7.3: sacchikatan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || pe || āloko udapādi || || 12.
sn56.11:8.1: Idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || ||
sn56.11:8.2: Tam kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccam bhāvetabban ti me bhikkhave ||
sn56.11:8.3: pa || bhāvitan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || || 13.
sn56.11:9.1: Yāva kīvañca me bhikkhave imesu catusu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaḍassanaṃ na suvisuddham ahosi || neva tāvāham bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddho ti paccaññāsiṃ || || 14.
sn56.11:10.1: Yato ca kho me bhikkhave imesu catusu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭam dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtam ñāṇadassanaṃ suvisuddham ahosi || athāham bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaram sammāsambodhim abhisambuddho ti paccaññāsiṃ ||
sn56.11:10.3: Akuppā me cetovimutti ayam antimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavo ti || || 15.
sn56.11:10.5: attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanduṃ || imasmiṃ
sn56.11:11.1: ca pana veyyākaraṇasmim bhaññamāne āyasmato Koṇḍaññassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhum udapādi ||
sn56.11:11.2: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabban taṃ nirodhadhamman ti || || 16. Evam
sn56.11:12.1: pavattite ca pana Bhagavatā dhammacakke Bhummā devā saddam anussāvesuṃ || ||
sn56.11:12.2: Etam Bhagavatā Bārāṇasiyam Isipatane Migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkam pavattitaṃ appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmin ti || || 17.
sn56.11:12.3: Bhummānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā Cātummahārājikā devā saddam anussāvesuṃ || ||
sn56.11:12.4: Etam Bhagavatā Bārāṇasiyam Isipatane Migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkam pavattitam appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmuṇā vā kenaci vā lokasmin ti || || 18.
sn56.11:12.5: Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā Tāvaṭiṃsā devā
sn56.11:12.11: Etam Bhagavatā Bārāṇasiyaṃ Isipatane Migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkam pavattitaṃ appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmin ti || || 19.
sn56.11:13.1: Iti ha tena khaṇena tena layena tena muhuttena yāva Brahmalokā saddo abbhuggacchi ||
sn56.11:13.2: ayañ ca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṃkampi sampakampi sampavedhi || appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātur ahosi atikkamma devānaṃ devānubhāvan ti || || 20.
sn56.11:14.2: Aññāsi vata bho Koṇḍañño aññāsi vata bho Koṇḍañño ti || ||
sn56.11:14.3: Iti hidam āyasmato Koṇḍaññassa Aññāta-Koṇḍañño tveva nāmam ahosī
